changelog:
The settings hub now shows how many options are on: one quiet row states the total and the areas carrying it, e.g. "17 on in 5 areas".
Every settings area shows its own exact count in its row summary ("3 of 12 on") and stays silent while the area is completely off.
Counts are read live from the stored settings and never write anything: a control without a storage key is not an option, and two controls sharing one key count once.
message: Dev build v855 - See how many CSM options are on, and where
